label: late-episode (low value) while leaning toward a2, off S1/a1 inputs
explanation: Fires only in the last ~15 trials of an episode (ep_trial 80-99 hold ~99.6% of mass; zero activity before trial 60), equivalently when the value head is low (value < 5.22 bin holds 94% of mass, the value decays as the remaining trials run out). Within that end-of-episode regime it is gated by the a2/S2 side: it never fires when the S1 state input is shown at D2, rarely when the a1 action input is present, and mostly when the policy favors a2 (choice < 0). Magnitude ramps up over successive trials toward the episode end (activations grow trial by trial within a window), and is larger at GO than D2. Predicate uses only observed inputs and model outputs (value, choice); no future variables. Dev F1 0.74, mass recall 0.90; false positives are mostly the earliest end-of-episode steps where the ramp has not crossed threshold, and misses are weak activations on a1/S1 trials.
